radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Reporting Institution: Erasmus MC University Medical Center | Date: 22 January 2025
Rationale: Evaluation of rising PSA value: "4.2" alongside clinical suspicion of malignancy.
Observations: The gland measures prostate volume: "23.73" on assessment. T2 sequences identify a discrete, hypointense focus measuring roughly 12 mm within the left peripheral zone at mid-gland level. DWI exhibits pronounced restriction with matching low ADC signal. DCE sequences demonstrate early, focal enhancement compared to adjacent tissue. No extraprostatic extension or seminal vesicle invasion is noted. Pelvic lymph nodes remain normal in size.
Conclusion: PI-RADS: "4" lesion in the left peripheral zone, mid-gland.
PSA density: "0.177" ng/mL/mL.
csPCa probability: "0.7802015"
